attributes.board_name: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions – State Board for Mental Health Practitioners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Formal courses from NYSED Department-approved mental health counseling CE providers (1 hour = 50 minutes); also first-time teaching/presentations for approved providers, peer-reviewed articles (2 h), books (5 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt during the initial three-year registration period; the next (birth-month adjusted) period requires 1 hour per month.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the registration renewal; keep certificates 6 years; registration placed on hold if requirement not met.

topics.who: All registered licensees (registration periods starting on or after April 1, 2023); counts toward the 36 hours

rules.notes: Self-study max 12 hours per 36 months (1/3 for other period lengths); live online courses unlimited. Child-abuse identification/reporting training (2 h) is an initial licensure requirement; updated mandated-reporter curriculum due by Nov 17, 2026.
rules.legal_basis: Education Law Article 163 (§8412); Regulations of the Commissioner Subpart 79-9 (§79-9.8)
